<CV 1,19>What is this?
Where is it coming from!?

This is...
Yes, what should I do?
<MWT 2>(A strange monster is on a rampage.)

<MWT 2>(An Arzuros smelling of sweets,
and a monster of unknown identity.)

<MWT 2>(At this rate it may harm
the ecosystem too.
It is very dangerous!)

<MWT 2>(So I want you to slay it!
Of course, not for free.)

<MWT 2>(Gather the <COL C70101FF>≪Grief Seeds≫</COL>
monsters drop, and at the <COL C70101FF>≪Exchange≫</COL>
I'll trade for what you want.)

<MWT 2>(For example, a weapon with
an unusual Art — how about that?
I'll leave it at the Exchange!)
<MWT 2>(Then, I leave the slaying to you!)
